issues.claim: Lyneer Staffing (Perth Amboy branch) is treated as an independent prospect
issues.problem: Excluded chain: Lyneer describes itself as having 100+ locations nationwide and a third-party directory lists offices in a dozen states. The mapper excluded Partners Personnel and Remedy on exactly this basis, so this entry is inconsistent with their own rule. Its address is also doubtful: the entry says 303 Maple St / (732) 934-5866, while a mapping-service listing gives 159 New Brunswick Ave / (732) 613-0088.
issues.fix: Drop Lyneer Staffing, or move it to the excluded/chain note. If kept, re-verify the branch address and phone before outreach.

issues.claim: On Target Staffing is an independent local staffing agency
issues.problem: Excluded chain: On Target Staffing lists 13 New Jersey branches (HQ North Brunswick) including the 291 Smith St Perth Amboy branch. Multi-branch 'brand' agency of the type the mapper excluded elsewhere.
issues.fix: Remove, or reclassify as a chain branch and note it does not fit the owner-operated target profile.

issues.claim: Vitality Staffing (144 New Brunswick Ave) is an independent agency
issues.problem: Chain/ambiguous: Vitality Staffing Solutions publishes four NJ offices (Union City, Elizabeth, New Brunswick, Trenton) and none of them is the 144 New Brunswick Ave Perth Amboy address in the entry, which comes only from a Yellow Pages page. Both the chain test and the address are unresolved.
issues.fix: Verify the Perth Amboy address on a page that can be opened; if it is only a Yellow Pages record, drop the entry or mark it unverified-chain.

issues.claim: First Care Chiropractic - Perth Amboy (511 New Brunswick Ave) fits the mapper's at-most-two-offices rule
issues.problem: The firm's own site lists four facilities - Perth Amboy, Trenton, East Orange and Hamilton - so it is a four-office group, which the mapper's own caveat says should be excluded (they excluded SportsMed and multi-office law firms on that basis).
issues.fix: Either apply the multi-office rule consistently and remove, or rewrite the rule to say multi-office groups are acceptable and re-check the other exclusions against it.

issues.claim: Morillo Eye Centers (Perth Amboy) is a small two-office practice
issues.problem: The practice's own site lists five locations: Hackensack, Newark, Union City, Passaic and Perth Amboy. It is a five-office regional chain, not a two-office local firm, and so violates the mapper's stated rule.
issues.fix: Apply the multi-office rule consistently (remove or downgrade), and correct the entry note, which says only 'Also an Edison office'.

issues.claim: SparQ Dental Perth Amboy office at 288 State St
issues.problem: The Perth Amboy office page could not be read for an address (it renders as a bare appointment form, and the page title mislabels it 'in West Long Branch'), and the practice's own location pages that I could read are West Long Branch and Linden only. The 288 State St / (732) 442-6100 detail appears only in search summaries, not on a page I could open.
issues.fix: Open the Perth Amboy location page in a browser or call the office before treating this as a live Perth Amboy prospect; note the missing address in the entry.

issues.claim: MoneyTax Service Center LLC operates a Perth Amboy office at 305 Maple St
issues.problem: Google Maps does show 'MoneyTax Service Center LLC, 305 Maple St, (732) 347-8856' (4.7, 27 reviews), but the firm's own site markets only Sayreville, Woodbridge and Edison, gives no address and never mentions Perth Amboy. The only in-zone evidence is a map pin, which the entry's own note concedes.
issues.fix: Keep only as an unverified/low-priority prospect with 'confirm the Perth Amboy office is staffed' in the notes, or drop until a phone check confirms it.

issues.claim: Martin Kane & Kuper Perth Amboy office at 511 New Brunswick Ave, (732) 572-7880
issues.problem: The firm's site (opened) confirms only 'offices conveniently located in East Brunswick or Perth Amboy' - no street address or phone anywhere on the page. The Perth Amboy address in the entry is not supported by any page I could open.
issues.fix: Keep the firm but mark address/phone as third-party (directory) data, or replace with a firm page that prints the Perth Amboy address.

issues.claim: Perusa Tax Services and Vas Law, LLC have unknown addresses
issues.problem: Both are real and local, but the entries leave address and phone blank even though each firm publishes them: Perusa's own contact page shows 362 Mechanic Street, Perth Amboy 08861 and 732.824.9799; Vas Law's address is given as 65 Smith Street, Perth Amboy in a business-credit directory.
issues.fix: Fill in Perusa from its contact page and Vas Law from a verified page (call the number on vas-law.com to confirm 65 Smith St) before triage.

issues.claim: Bose Tax & Accounting LLC is a Perth Amboy prospect
issues.problem: Address and phone are 'Unknown' in the entry and its own site would not load for me (request aborted/blocked). A search summary attributes an Otlowski Ct address and (800) 226-9050 to the firm, but I could not confirm either on a page.
issues.fix: Verify the Perth Amboy office address and phone on the firm's site or by phone; otherwise drop it as unconfirmed.

issues.claim: Three separate businesses all sit at 330 State St (Rita Salon, Zuleymy's Beauty Express, GR Luxury Spa)
issues.problem: Rita Salon's own site never shows an address, and the mapper's own note says a directory lists an older Fayette St address for it; GR Luxury Spa is listed as being inside Zuleymy's. Three entries sharing one address suggests at least one stale address or a suite mix-up.
issues.fix: Confirm unit numbers for all three (or the current Rita Salon address) before mailing or calling.

issues.claim: Perth Amboy Pediatrics (468 Amboy Ave) is an independent practice
issues.problem: The only evidence is a Hackensack Meridian Health network provider page, i.e. a hospital-system directory. If the practice is system-owned it falls under the hospital exclusion; the entry itself flags the risk.
issues.fix: Check the practice's own listing/phone before adding to outreach; drop if it is a health-system site (like the already-excluded Hackensack Meridian rehab and CJMC entries).

issues.problem: Nine eligible, non-excluded businesses I found in the zone are not in the list (see coverage.missing), including a dentist, two tax offices, a chiropractor, an insurance agency, a surveyor and two barbershops.
issues.fix: Add the missing businesses (or record why each was rejected) before the list is used as a prospecting base.
